assessment_objectives.objective: sensitive / regulated data flows are identified and documented.
a Data Flow Diagram (DFD) exists for each type of sensitive / regulated data that is stored, processed and/or transmitted.
a process exists to review DFDs for accuracy per an organization-defined frequency.
a process exists to update DFDs upon technology or business practice changes that affect where sensitive / regulated data is stored, processed and/or transmitted.
one or more high-level network diagrams exist as a schematic to identify the logical placement of systems, applications and services at a conceptual level.
one or more low-level network diagrams exist as a schematic to identify the detailed logical and physical placement of systems, applications and services.
a process exists to review network diagrams for accuracy per an organization-defined frequency.
a process exists to update network diagrams upon changes to technologies.
